name: San Mateo
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in San Mateo, CA 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in San Mateo, CA: Winter Wonderland in Central Park, the Winter Wonder Walk, ice skating and a family holiday concert.
lede: San Mateo's Christmas centers on Central Park, with a Winter Wonderland of Santa and a tree lighting, an ice rink, a neighborhood Winter Wonder Walk and holiday concerts.
celebrates: San Mateo Parks and Recreation holds Winter Wonderland at Central Park and the Central Recreation Center on December 5, with Santa, a tree lighting and food and craft vendors. The San Mateo Area Chamber of Commerce runs the Winter Wonder Walk on 25th Avenue the night before, with live music, makers and family activities. San Mateo on Ice sets up an ice rink in Central Park, and the Masterworks Chorale holds a family holiday concert with children admitted free. San Mateo Public Library also hosts holiday concerts in its Oak Room.
lastyear: Winter Wonderland returned on Saturday, December 6, 2025, from 5 to 7 pm at Central Park, with crafts, dance performances and Santa, according to the city's Parks and Recreation post. This year the city's post calls Winter Wonderland the year's final event and sets it for Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 5 to 7 pm at Central Park and the Central Recreation Center. Admission is free and open to all, according to the Downtown San Mateo Association.
facts: San Mateo is named for St. Matthew and was incorporated on September 4, 1894. It is the most populous city in San Mateo County, with 105,661 residents at the 2020 census. Central Park is the city's signature park, with a Japanese tea garden, a miniature train, a rose garden and the San Mateo Arboretum. Ice skating in the park is a December tradition.
trains: San Mateo has three Caltrain stations: San Mateo, Hayward Park and Hillsdale. The San Mateo station is a short ride from downtown, so families can take the train to the Central Park events. Central Park also has a miniature train for little riders. For a bigger train day, San Francisco has a cable car museum and a railway museum for streetcar fans.

traditions: Santa, a tree lighting, food and craft vendors and activities at Central Park and the Central Recreation Center.
The chamber's evening stroll on 25th Avenue with makers, music and family activities.
A seasonal ice rink in Central Park with skates included.
The Masterworks Chorale's concert, with children admitted free.
San Mateo Public Library hosts holiday music in its Oak Room in December.
kidfact: San Mateo's Central Park has a real miniature train, a Japanese tea garden and a rose garden, and in December it also gets an ice rink.
faq: When is Winter Wonderland in San Mateo?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 5 to 7 pm at Central Park and the Central Recreation Center, according to the city. It is free and open to all.
Is there ice skating in San Mateo?
Yes. San Mateo on Ice runs a rink in Central Park, with public skate and skates included in the price.
What is the Winter Wonder Walk?
A chamber event on 25th Avenue between Flores and Hacienda Streets on Friday, December 4, 2026, from 4:30 to 7:30 pm with makers, music and food.
Which Caltrain stations serve San Mateo?
San Mateo, Hayward Park and Hillsdale stations.
Is there a family holiday concert?
The Masterworks Chorale performs on December 12 with children free and adults paying.
sources: San Mateo Area Chamber of Commerce
